name: Offside
verdict: Saudi sportswear brand operated by Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Company. Nothing found.
note: Kit supplier to Al-Fateh for 2026/27 (433FC kit-sponsor table; the club's partners page lists أوفسايد linking offsideksa.com, and Offside's own store sells the club's 26/27 shirts). Also supplies Abha and Al-Shabab in the Saudi Pro League. Rating note: Al-Kas sports newspaper (3 December 2025) identifies Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Company as the company behind the OffSide – OffLimits trade name. No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
